title: Software Development Engineer, Everyday Essentials Experiences
description:
**Description**
The Everyday Essentials Experience Org delivers a world-class shopping experience for everyday essentials that is efficient, habitual, and economical for customers and selling partners. We are looking for a Software Development Engineer with strong ownership and a drive to solve complex, large-scale problems through creative solutions.
  
  
The Everyday Essential Cost to Serve team drives multi-million dollar cost savings for Amazon through its multipack programs. The team owns how Amazon represents, prices, and fulfills multipack products worldwide, and is currently executing a ground-up re-architecture of the multipack platform as a leadership-priority initiative, promoting multipacks to first-class purchasable products. This work changes how millions of customers discover, purchase, and receive multipacks, and how selling partners manage their multipack catalog.
  
  
What makes this role unique is the breadth. Your work will span the entire retail funnel: ASIN creation, catalog ingestion, pricing determination, selection and ranking, and customer-facing experiences on Search, Detail Page, Cart, Checkout,
  
  
and the multipacks storefront. You will work closely with the science team and have the opportunity to develop and influence the models that drive multipack selection and personalization. Few teams at Amazon offer this combination of
  
  
end-to-end systems exposure.
  
  
You will build systems that separate what a customer buys from how it is fulfilled, enabling seamless multipack experiences from online multipacks fulfilled with individual units to physical products shipped as a single item. You will have the freedom to experiment, propose new multipack experiences, and ship them worldwide. Your ideas move from whiteboard to production, visible to hundreds of millions of customers. You will shape foundational decisions in an active re-architecture program with high visibility to senior leadership
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  
Design, build, and own end-to-end software solutions that are scalable, reliable, and maintainable across the full software development lifecycle.
  
  
Collaborate with product managers, principal engineers, and cross-functional teams to translate business requirements into technical designs and working software.
  
  
Drive continuous improvement by identifying gaps in existing systems, proposing solutions, and delivering results with a high bar for quality and operational excellence.
  
  
Participate actively in code reviews, contribute to team best practices, and mentor junior engineers to raise the technical bar across the team.
  
  
Operate with a good sense of ownership — monitoring systems you build, responding to operational issues, and iterating quickly to improve customer and partner experience.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
* 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
* Experience programming with at least one software programming language
* Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

**Preferred Qualifications**

* 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience

title: Software Engineer, Risk Management
description:
**About Us**

Hyperproof is on a mission to transform the Governance, Risk, and Compliance (GRC) world with a powerful new software platform. With Hyperproof, companies can save time and money while also operating their programs at a much higher level of effectiveness and accountability. We envision a world where organizations we depend on are truly trustworthy — and Hyperproof is the platform that will get them there.

We have a great team and culture — picture yourself in a highly collaborative startup environment where you can make a real impact on something truly important. It's an exciting time to be at Hyperproof; we raised our Series B round in 2023, validating our teamwork and company vision, and we continue to grow rapidly.

As we continue to grow, we are seeking a talented Software Engineer to join our Risk Management team and help build first-party risk management features that help our customers identify, assess, and mitigate organizational risk.

**Who You Are**

You are a full-stack engineer with 3–5 years of experience who cares about building software that is correct, reliable, and genuinely useful. You thrive working across the stack — comfortable designing APIs in the morning and refining React components in the afternoon. You take pride in writing code that is well-tested and maintainable, and you understand that in a compliance domain, data integrity is not optional.

You are excited by the challenge of translating complex domain logic — risk scoring, control testing, framework alignment — into clean, intuitive product experiences. You are comfortable asking questions, engaging in design discussions, and owning features end-to-end. You work well in a collaborative, async-first environment.

**What You Will Do**

As a Software Engineer on the Risk Management team, your responsibilities will include:

* Design, build, and ship first-party risk management features including risk register, inherent and residual risk scoring, and risk lifecycle workflows.
* Develop and extend control testing and monitoring capabilities — automated evidence checks, test cadence scheduling, and pass/fail logic tied to compliance outcomes.
* Build integrations with compliance frameworks including SOC 2, ISO 27001, NIST CSF, and others — enabling customers to map their controls and risks to the standards that matter to them.
* Collaborate with product managers and designers to translate compliance domain requirements into reliable, intuitive product experiences.
* Write backend services and APIs in C# (.NET), Node.js, and/or Python that are performant, well-documented, and testable.
* Build and maintain React/TypeScript front-end components that surface complex risk data in clean, actionable dashboards.
* Participate in design reviews and code reviews, contributing to engineering quality across the team.
* Work closely with QA to ensure correctness — you understand that in a compliance product, data integrity issues have real consequences for our customers.

**What You Will Bring**

**Required:**

* 3–5 years of software engineering experience in a product-focused company.
* Strong proficiency in React and TypeScript for front-end development.
* Experience with at least one of Java Springboot, Node.js, or Python for back-end API development.
* Comfort working across the full stack — you can own a feature from data model to UI.
* Familiarity with relational databases (PostgreSQL preferred) and writing efficient, well-structured queries.
* Solid understanding of REST API design principles and asynchronous patterns.
* A track record of writing well-tested code; you care about test coverage and the long-term cost of technical debt.
* Excellent communication skills; you can engage effectively in async and cross-functional team environments.
* A positive attitude and willingness to learn, adapt, and grow in a dynamic environment.

**Preferred:**

* Exposure to GRC, compliance, audit, or risk management domains — even as an end user.
* Familiarity with compliance frameworks such as SOC 2, ISO 27001, NIST CSF, or FedRAMP.
* Experience building workflow-heavy or state-machine-driven features.
* Familiarity with risk registers, control frameworks, or evidence management concepts.
* Prior experience in a B2B SaaS environment.

**Location**

We are a fully remote company! This role is open to candidates based in India. Rather than restrict ourselves to only finding talent in one city, we'd rather find the absolute best people regardless of where they live.

**Where You'll Go**

* Hyperproof also loves to see an internal transfer. If a linear career path is not what you're looking for, you can work with your manager and our people team to explore lateral moves to other parts of the organization as you continue to grow with us.

**Compensation**

* ₹2,137,000 - ₹3,000,000

**WHERE YOU’LL GO**

* Hyperproof also loves to see an internal transfer. If a linear career path is not what you’re looking for, you can work with your manager and our people team to explore lateral moves to other parts of the organization as you continue to grow with us.

**WHAT WE OFFER TO OUR EMPLOYEES**

**Please note: Benefits listed below are for employees in the United States; contractor roles or international positions may differ**

* Annual compensation reviews + equity
* Unlimited PTO: strongly encouraged to unplug and recharge
* Health: coverage for medical, dental, and vision - employee and dependents

* $100 quarterly paid wellness stipend

It’s an exciting time to be at Hyperproof — we recently raised $40 million in our Series B financing, further cementing Hyperproof as the emerging leader in the risk and compliance management space.

At Hyperproof’s core are our passionate team members who focus on user experience, beautiful design, and evangelize a positive social impact of our cloud based platform. We help organizations streamline their risk and compliance workflows so our customers can spend more time strategically managing programs and less time wrangling spreadsheets.

We are disrupting the governance, risk, and compliance software space with our innovative platform by helping traditionally unsung heroes (compliance professionals)
**do the right things so the wrong things don’t happen.**

Learn more about the @hyperproof culture and how it all started.

title: Senior AI Engineer
description:
**About Teleradiology Solutions / Daignostix**

Teleradiology Solutions (TRS), founded in 2002 by two Yale-trained physicians and headquartered in Ardmore, PA, provides 24x7 diagnostic radiology reporting to over 150 hospitals across 21 countries, through a network of radiologists (US, Indian certified) and technology-driven workflows.

Daignostix, the AI arm of TRS based in Whitefield, Bengaluru, builds clinical AI for medical imaging and healthcare workflows. TRS also maintains an active academic and research focus, including AI in radiology (www.radguru.net).

**Role Summary:**

Daignostix builds clinical AI for medical imaging, with algorithms spanning neuro and stroke, pulmonary embolism, aortic pathology, urology, spine and rib fracture, solid-organ trauma and paediatric chest. Our models run on real patient studies alongside radiologists (US, Indian certified), so success means clinical accuracy, robustness, latency and safe operation in production.

As a Senior AI Engineer, you will own clinical AI algorithms end to end: problem formulation, data and ground truth, modelling, clinical evaluation, production deployment and monitoring. This is a hands-on senior individual-contributor role for an engineer who has already shipped and operated production AI systems.

**Roles and Responsibilities:**

● End-to-end algorithm ownership. Own one or more clinical AI algorithms from proposal through data strategy, modelling, validation, deployment, monitoring and improvement. Define the technical plan, flag risks early and drive decisions to closure.

● Model development. Design and train CNN, transformer and hybrid models for classification, detection and segmentation, using classical ML where it is the better fit.

● Data and ground truth. Architect DICOM pipelines and dataset curation with lineage and versioning. Catch leakage, label-quality issues, cohort bias and scanner/site variability before they become model problems.

● Clinical evaluation. Define evaluation protocols, clinical metrics, calibration and subgroup analyses. Lead false-positive/false-negative review and threshold selection with radiologists (US, Indian certified).

● Production engineering. Turn validated models into production services (Docker, FastAPI/REST) with robust GPU inference, observability and safe failure behaviour. Optimise with ONNX, TensorRT or CUDA where it measurably helps without changing clinical outputs.

● MLOps and reliability. Deploy on AWS, Azure or GCP and on on-premise GPU infrastructure. Own experiment tracking, model registries, CI/CD, regression and golden-set testing, drift monitoring and rollback.

● Technical leadership. Lead design, code and model-readiness reviews, mentor junior engineers and set engineering standards. This role has no people-management responsibility.

**Requirements:**

**Must-have:**

● Education. B.Tech/B.E./M.Tech/MS/M.Sc. from an IIT, IISc, IIIT, BITS Pilani or a comparably selective institution, in Computer Science, Electrical/Electronics Engineering, AI, Data Science, Mathematics, Statistics or a related quantitative field, with a strong academic record.

● Experience. 5-8 years of hands-on AI/ML engineering, including multiple years taking deep-learning systems into production. Medical-imaging or healthcare AI experience is strongly preferred.

● Product pedigree. Substantive AI/ML engineering experience at a leading medical-imaging AI company or a top-tier AI product or research organisation, with clear ownership of production AI products.

● Proof of production ownership. Able to walk through at least two AI/ML systems you personally drove from data through deployment, monitoring and iteration, with measurable outcomes.

● Programming. Expert Python, deep PyTorch and/or TensorFlow/Keras, and working proficiency in NumPy, scikit-learn and OpenCV.

● ML depth. Strong command of deep learning, computer vision, classical ML, statistics, calibration and experimental design.

● Production engineering. Linux, Git, Docker, FastAPI/REST, pytest, CI/CD, logging and monitoring, model/data versioning, and hands-on AWS, Azure or GCP.

**Good-to-have:**

● Scale and performance. Kubernetes, distributed training/inference, ONNX/TensorRT, CUDA profiling and infrastructure-as-code.

● Medical imaging tooling. DICOM/NIfTI, MONAI and nnU-Net.

● Multimodal AI. VLMs, LLMs, RAG and PEFT, as an addition to, not a substitute for, core deep-learning depth.

**Key Skills:**

Python | PyTorch | TensorFlow / Keras | NumPy | scikit-learn | OpenCV | Classical ML | CNNs | Vision Transformers | Detection | Segmentation | DICOM / NIfTI | MONAI / nnU-Net | Clinical Metrics | Calibration | Docker | FastAPI | pytest | CI/CD | MLflow / Weights & Biases | AWS / Azure / GCP | Kubernetes | ONNX / TensorRT

**Why Join Daignostix:**

● Clinical AI that matters. Algorithms evaluated on real patient studies, where robustness, latency and reliability have direct operational consequences.

● Direct access to radiologists. Work with subspecialist radiologists (US, Indian certified) on annotation strategy, threshold decisions and clinical failure analysis.

● Senior influence, hands-on scope. Shape architecture and technical standards across GPU infrastructure, cloud and on-premise deployment, while staying close to code and data.

description:

**Job: Senior Red Team Engineer, Endpoint TTPs & Malware Development**
**Description**
We're hiring a senior offensive security engineer to join our growing Adversary Simulation (AdSim) team. We are looking for our first endpoint and malware development specialist: someone who can own initial access, persistence, payload development, evasion research, offensive tooling, and assist with hands-on execution during AdSim exercises.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**
You’re someone who is excited to reverse engineer security products, develop custom malware and endpoint tradecraft, and assist with operating those capabilities during exercises while evading live defenders. You’ll help provide insights into improved prevention and detection strategies for our defenders to consider.
  
  
**Specifically, You Will**

* Design, develop, and maintain custom offensive tooling, malware, loaders, implants, payloads, Beacon Object Files (BOFs), endpoint persistence mechanisms, and supporting operational infrastructure.
* Conduct malware development, malware analysis, reverse engineering, exploit development, and offensive security research inspired by Threat Intelligence, real-world adversary TTPs, and the candidate’s own research and development.
* Operate hands-on during AdSim exercises, including covert, purple team, and targeted exercises.
* Evaluate and challenge common EDR/AV platforms, log collection, behavioral analysis, network monitoring, identity protection, and other detective and preventative controls.
* Partner with SOC, Incident Response, Threat Intelligence, and Detection Engineering teams to improve prevention, detection, and response capabilities.
* Translate technical findings into business risk and deliver actionable detection and remediation guidance.
* Use and develop AI-assisted testing, automation, perform adversarial LLM research, and build offensive security workflows to accelerate capability development and operational effectiveness.
* Help shape the future direction of AI-enabled adversary simulation, endpoint tradecraft, malware development, and AdSim exercises.

**What You Bring**
Candidates will be evaluated based on their ability to perform the duties listed above while demonstrating the required skills and competencies necessary to be highly effective in the role. Preferred experience and certifications are nice to have, not required.
  
  
**Required Experience And Skills**

* 5+ years of experience in red teaming, adversary simulation, offensive security engineering, malware development, exploit development, or advanced penetration testing.
* Demonstrated experience operating against mature enterprise environments protected by modern security controls.
* Strong software development skills in C, C++, C#, Rust, Go, Python, or similar languages, with demonstrated experience building offensive or security tooling.
* Proven experience developing or modifying custom malware, loaders, implants, payloads, BOFs, endpoint persistence techniques, evasions, ETW patching, AMSI bypass, and operational tooling.
* Strong reverse engineering, malware analysis, and exploit development capabilities, including analyzing malware, operating system components, and commercial security products.
* Deep understanding of Windows internals, Active Directory, authentication protocols, endpoint telemetry, and modern defensive technologies.
* Strong understanding of how EDR/AV, log collection, behavioral analysis, network monitoring, identity protections, and other detective and preventative controls identify adversary activity.
* Experience using AI-driven tools and workflows to accelerate software development, research, automation, and offensive security activity, including interest in adversarial use of LLMs.
* Ability to communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders and collaborate closely with defensive teams.

**Nice-to-have Experience**

* Broader red teaming knowledge in one or more additional areas such as cloud security across Azure, AWS, or GCP; application security; web application testing; phishing and social tradecraft; identity attack paths; Active Directory tradecraft; Linux or macOS endpoint internals and tradecraft, including macOS SIP, execution, persistence, telemetry, and security control behavior; wireless or physical security; exploit development; vulnerability research; custom C2 framework development; C2 extension, module, or profile development; or large-scale offensive infrastructure.
* Game hacking, game security, or anti-cheat bypass research against EAC, BattlEye, Vanguard, or similar platforms, with experience in internal/external tooling, Ring 3/Ring 0 tradecraft, manual mapping, injection, hooking/unhooking, kernel callbacks, memory scanning, overlays, driver-assisted tooling, and detection-surface reduction.
* Public research, conference presentations, blogs, tool releases, or open-source contributions.
* Experience with kernel development, kernel security research, advanced vulnerability research, or commercial security product research.
* Nice-to-have certifications include OSEP, OSED, OSCP, CRTO, GXPN, GREM, or equivalent hands-on offensive security certifications. No certifications are required.

**Why This Role**
The AdSim Team is building the team we know sets the bar: sharp enough to evade mature defenses, malleable enough to simulate a range of adversaries, and technical enough to build the capabilities other offensive teams dream about. You’ll build custom tooling, develop endpoint tradecraft, operate during realistic exercises, and chase the research that matters. If you want challenging work and the chance to help build one of the best AdSim teams in the space, help us build it at The Hartford

title: Computer Vision & AI Intern
description:
The role

We're building an on-premise computer vision system that detects operator fatigue and man-down events on our production floor, using cameras already installed. Alerts go to the operator first; escalation only on a genuine safety event. No video leaves the machine.

This is a safety project & productivity monitoring — we're preventing fatigue-related incidents

What you'll build

* Ingest : Audit our existing cameras — RTSP access, frame rate, night IR coverage, pixels-per-metre. Build a multi-stream pipeline with hardware decode.
* Detection : Person detection and tracking; pose estimation for posture (standing / slumped / prone); motion-energy from keypoint variance; eye-state/PERCLOS where resolution allows. Fuse into a state machine that needs two independent signals and sustained evidence before it alerts.
* Measurement : Hand-label ground truth from our own footage, including night shift and full PPE. Measure false positive and negative rates per camera. Tune and document thresholds. Test explicitly across PPE, lighting, distance and skin tone, and report any disparity.
* Reporting : Event store, Grafana dashboard, written evaluation and a clear recommendation: proceed, change approach, or stop.

You need

Strong Python. Computer vision fundamentals — detection, pose estimation, tracking. OpenCV and comfort with video (codecs, frame rates, RTSP). PyTorch enough to run, fine-tune and evaluate a model. Linux, ffmpeg, basic networking, Git. Above all, the instinct to measure rather than assume.

Nice to have: TensorRT/ONNX Runtime, GStreamer or DeepStream, MediaPipe, YOLO-family models, RTMPose, ByteTrack, Grafana, MQTT, or any exposure to industrial environments and SCADA/PLCs.

Eligibility & applying

Enrolled in or recently graduated from CS, EE/ECE, Robotics or similar.

Send a CV and a short note on a CV or video project you've built: what it did, how you measured whether it worked, what you'd do differently.

*Shortlisted candidates get a ~2-hour exercise: given a short video of a person at a desk, report per second whether they're present and whether they're moving. We're assessing approach and handling of ambiguous cases, not polish.*

*NOTE : This is a paid internship.*

* Strong understanding of HiL and SiL testing concepts and their application in Rolling Stock projects.

* Experience building or operating multi-tenant SaaS or cloud platform capabilities.
* Experience with AI evaluation, observability, security controls, governance, or other production foundations for agentic systems.

* Delivery of solutions conforming to agreed specifications and architecture that leverage agentic AI to solve valuable customer problems in a way that is explainable and repeatable – resulting in measurable productivity improvements.

You’ll work closely with senior Red Team operators and security engineering partners to execute scoped exercises, produce clear evidence of exploitable paths, and translate offensive findings into practical risk reduction.

* Support operations: Assist in planning and execution of approved adversary simulation exercises across endpoints, identity, applications, cloud, and third-party integrations, with guidance from senior operators.

* Build technical depth: Help maintain lab environments, test infrastructure, and approved tooling while following established safety and OPSEC practices.
* Learn and share tradecraft: Contribute to team standards, document lessons learned, and participate in peer reviews of techniques, findings, and reports.
* Apply and assess LLMs: Use LLMs to support authorized offensive security operations, including research, scripting, analysis, tooling, and workflow automation, and evaluate LLM-enabled systems for weaknesses that could contribute to an attack path.
* Follow safety and compliance practices: Operate within defined scope, approvals, deconfliction steps, and engagement rules for all activities.

* Experience: 1 to 3 years in offensive security, penetration testing, Red Team operations, adversary simulation, or hands-on security engineering with offensive testing exposure.
* Technical foundation: Solid working knowledge of Windows and Linux internals, cloud security, AI/LLM, common enterprise attack paths, and at least one major cloud platform such as AWS, Azure, or GCP.
* Framework fluency: Practical familiarity with MITRE ATT&CK, including the ability to map and demonstrate Red Team procedures against tactics, techniques, objectives, and enterprise risk.
* Scripting and tooling: Practical experience writing or modifying scripts in PowerShell, Python, Go, Rust, or C#, with enough depth to automate operator tasks, adapt approved tooling, handle output, and troubleshoot execution issues.

* Automated security testing: Experience planning and managing test execution across a range of automated security testing tools, validating results, tracking coverage, and delivering clear, actionable reports.

title: Senior AI Engineer
description:
**Our Purpose**
*Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.*
**Title And Summary**
Senior AI Engineer
  
  
Mastercard's Business & Market Insights (B&MI) group empowers organizations to achieve growth and innovation goals by delivering unparalleled data-driven intelligence and cutting-edge AI solutions. By harnessing proprietary data, frontier generative AI, and global expertise, B&MI helps businesses make smarter, faster, and more impactful decisions. We transform complex, multi-modal data into agentic systems and generative applications that drive measurable business outcomes and sustained competitive advantage.
  
  
We're looking for a Senior AI Engineer, Generative AI & ML Engineering, for the Operational Intelligence Program within B&MI. In this hands-on role, you'll design, build, and ship production-grade agentic AI systems. These include agents that make extensive tool calls into enterprise services and APIs, handle complex multi-step workflows, and deliver secure, scalable, reliable results. You'll work across agent orchestration, tool calling, memory, retrieval, and LLMOps, help set the engineering standard for Gen AI development, and mentor other engineers on the team. Much of this work is strong backend engineering. If you bring deep experience building production services and have started building with LLMs, we'd love to
  
  
Roles & Responsibilities
  
  

* Architect and build the tool-calling layer that powers our agents: wrap internal services, data platforms, and external APIs as well-defined tools with clear schemas, contracts, and permissions.
* Engineer reliable tool execution at scale, including parallel and chained tool calls, timeouts, retries, idempotency, error recovery, and graceful handling of tool failures or bad model outputs.
* Develop high-performance Python backend services for LLM orchestration, covering async job handling, streaming responses, caching, rate limiting, and distributed workflows supporting high-throughput Gen AI operations.
* Engineer state, memory, and context management subsystems so agents can maintain session continuity across long, multi-step, tool-heavy interactions.
* Architect multi-agent and skills-based agent systems using frameworks such as LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen, or similar, enabling autonomous reasoning, tool use, inter-agent coordination, and adaptive decision-making at enterprise scale.
* Build observability for agent behavior, including end-to-end tracing of tool calls, measuring tool-selection accuracy, and debugging multi-step agent runs in production.
* Build retrieval systems (RAG and Graph-RAG) where agents need grounded knowledge, using vector databases (e.g., Pinecone, pgvector, OpenSearch) and knowledge graphs (e.g., Neo4j, AWS Neptune).
* Establish LLMOps and MLOps pipelines on Databricks (AWS), covering MLflow, prompt and agent evaluation, model lineage tracking, CI/CD, and monitoring.
* Design multimodal generative AI pipelines that unify text, image, tabular, and graph data using modern transformer-based and foundation models.
* Guide fine-tuning, prompt engineering, and alignment strategies (e.g., PEFT, LoRA, instruction tuning, RLHF) to adapt foundation models for specialized enterprise use cases, working closely with ML specialists.
* Implement Responsible AI practices, including hallucination mitigation, bias detection, output safety guardrails, explainability, and compliance with data ethics standards.
* Evaluate and productionize advances in agentic AI, multimodal models, and frontier foundation models, benchmarking them against enterprise performance and safety requirements.
* Lead, mentor, and grow a team of engineers, and set the engineering standard for Gen AI development across the program.

**All About You**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, AI/ML, or Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.
* A strong track record of building and operating production backend systems at scale, including distributed services, APIs, async processing, data stores, and observability.
* Strong API design and integration experience: you know how to build services that other systems, and now LLMs, can call safely and reliably.
* Excellent Python engineering skills, including async programming, API development (FastAPI or similar), and microservices, plus SQL proficiency.
* Hands-on experience shipping at least one LLM-powered application to production that uses tool/function calling, such as agents that call APIs, query databases, or trigger workflows. This can be with OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, or open-source models.
* A working understanding of Gen AI engineering patterns, such as prompt design, embeddings, semantic search, and agent memory, or a demonstrated ability to ramp up quickly on new technical domains.
* Experience with at least one cloud platform (AWS preferred; Azure or GCP welcome).
* Experience leading or mentoring engineers, plus strong communication and stakeholder management skills. You should be able to translate technical work into business value.
* Nice to have: experience with Model Context Protocol (MCP) or building tool servers and connectors for LLM agents.
* Nice to have: experience evaluating agent performance, such as tool-selection accuracy, task completion rates, or multi-step reasoning reliability.
* Nice to have: exposure to fine-tuning (LoRA, PEFT, RLHF), multimodal models, knowledge graphs, or MLOps tooling like MLflow, Weights & Biases, SageMaker, or Bedrock.
* Coming from a backend background? We value engineers who take AI from prototype to production as much as those who train the models. If you've built high-throughput systems and started applying those skills to LLM-powered products, we want to hear from you, even if you haven't worked with every tool listed here

**Corporate Security Responsibility**
All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:
  
  

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

title: AI Principle Architect
description:
**Our Purpose**
*Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.*
**Title And Summary**
AI Principle Architect
  
  
Mastercard's Business & Market Insights (B&MI) group empowers organizations to achieve growth and innovation goals by delivering unparalleled data-driven intelligence and cutting-edge AI solutions. By harnessing proprietary data, frontier generative AI, and global expertise, B&MI helps businesses make smarter, faster, and more impactful decisions. We transform complex, multi-modal data into agentic systems and generative applications that drive measurable business outcomes and sustained competitive advantage.
  
  
We're looking for a Principal Architect, Generative AI & ML Engineering, for the Operational Intelligence Program within B&MI. As a principal-level technical leader, you'll define the architecture vision and technical strategy for our agentic AI platform. On this platform, agents make extensive tool calls into enterprise services and APIs and must run securely, reliably, and at scale. You'll set the standards teams build on across tool calling, multi-agent orchestration, self-correcting agents, memory, retrieval, and LLMOps. You'll also make the key decisions on models, platforms, and trade-offs. Working closely with engineering, product, security, and business leaders, you'll shape the long-term direction of Gen AI across B&MI and mentor architects and senior engineers. You'll also stay hands-on with prototypes that de-risk big bets. The hardest problems in enterprise Gen AI are reliability, integration, security, and scale. If you've solved them as a backend or distributed systems architect and have started applying that experience to LLM systems, we'd love to hear from you.
  
  
Roles & Responsibilities
  
  

* Own the architecture and technical roadmap for the Operational Intelligence Gen AI platform, defining reference architectures and standards that teams across the program can reuse and scale.
* Architect the enterprise tool-calling layer, setting standards for how internal services, data platforms, and external APIs are exposed to agents as tools. This covers schemas, contracts, versioning, access control, and resilient execution (parallel and chained calls, retries, timeouts, idempotency, circuit breakers, and fallbacks).
* Set the architecture for multi-agent and skills-based agent systems (e.g., LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen), including when to use agents versus deterministic workflows and how agents coordinate, delegate, and share context.
* Design self-correcting agent patterns: tool critics and verifiers that check tool selection, arguments, and results, plus reflection and plan-and-execute loops that catch errors before agents act or respond.
* Architect agent memory and state for long-running, multi-step sessions, including short- and long-term memory (e.g., Mem0, Zep, LangGraph memory), session persistence, and memory scoping and retention.

* Own key architecture decisions and trade-offs, such as build versus buy, model and vendor selection, and cost versus latency versus accuracy, documented through architecture decision records. Assess emerging models, frameworks, and standards such as MCP for production readiness.

**All About You**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, AI/ML, or Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.
* Significant experience architecting large-scale distributed systems in production, including microservices, event-driven systems, data platforms, and cloud-native infrastructure.
* Deep expertise in API design and systems integration, including contracts, security models, and reliability patterns for services consumed by many teams. You understand what changes when the consumer is an LLM.
* Hands-on experience designing and shipping LLM-powered systems in production, especially agents that use tool/function calling, memory, and retrieval, and a clear view of how they fail.
* Strong Python skills for hands-on prototyping (async programming, FastAPI or similar), plus SQL proficiency.
* Deep experience with at least one major cloud platform (AWS preferred; Azure or GCP welcome), including its AI services such as Bedrock, SageMaker, Azure OpenAI, or Vertex AI.
* A solid grounding in security, privacy, and compliance for enterprise systems, ideally in financial services or another regulated industry.
